evals.prompt: I just downloaded vphone-launchpad 2.2.3 on a fresh Mac. Get me from here to a running machine called test01 using the newest firmware you can find. Show me the exact commands you would run and in what order; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Checks status first; links the CLI; installs a 2.2.x bundle (not a newer series); checks disk; vm create without hard-coded IPSWs (catalog default) or with explicit ones; vm start --wait; does not touch SIP/boot-args; mentions the admin password prompt.
assertions: Checks status or the installed CLI before creating anything
Installs a 2.2.x bundle and not a newer series
Runs vm create without hard-coded IPSW paths, or with explicit ones the user gave
Uses vm start --wait or a vm wait after vm start
Does not touch SIP or boot-args
Mentions the admin password prompt

evals.prompt: myphone is running. Open Settings, tell me what the screen shows, then read /etc/hosts from the guest. Show me the commands you would run; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Uses guest rpc apps.launch with bundle_id com.apple.Preferences, a screenshot to a file or ui.describe/ui.ocr (not the attached small image), files.read for /etc/hosts; no ssh, no devicectl.
assertions: Launches Settings with guest rpc apps.launch and bundle_id com.apple.Preferences
Gets the screen content via a screenshot written to a file, ui.describe or ui.ocr
Reads /etc/hosts with guest rpc files.read
Does not use ssh or devicectl

evals.prompt: myphone boots to a black screen but I can hear it is running. Plan how you would diagnose it. Do not create any new machines.
evals.expected_output: processes.list for SpringBoard, logs.crashes, reads the datamigrator stackshot, follows turnstileInfo, points at Research/Patches/hv_vmm_present_usermode_xrefs.md and Documents/en/help/troubleshooting.md; does not vm create to reproduce; stops and reports rather than changing host settings.
assertions: Checks processes.list for SpringBoard
Reads logs.crashes
Reads the datamigrator stackshot or follows turnstileInfo
Points at Research/Patches/hv_vmm_present_usermode_xrefs.md or Documents/en/help/troubleshooting.md
Does not run vm create to reproduce
Stops and reports instead of changing host settings

evals.prompt: I want ssh into myphone and a debuggable test IPA installed. It was just created. How do you do that, and where do I put the IPA so vphoned can read it?
evals.expected_output: Notes a fresh guest has no sshd; installs the roothide bootstrap, then owngoal-bootstrap-vphone; ssh lands in the jbroot and real root is /rootfs; warns apps.install deletes the file.
assertions: States that a fresh guest has no sshd
Installs the roothide bootstrap before owngoal-bootstrap-vphone
Installs owngoal-bootstrap-vphone to get ssh
States that ssh lands in the jbroot and the real root is /rootfs
Warns that apps.install deletes the IPA file

evals.prompt: Start the machine called dev02 and then list its installed apps. Show me the exact commands you would run, in order; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: vm start with --wait (or vm wait) before guest rpc apps.list; never rpc right after a bare vm start.
assertions: Runs vm wait or uses --wait before any guest rpc
Does not call guest rpc straight after a bare vm start
Explains or acts on the fact that vm start returns before the guest agent is ready

evals.prompt: I ran `guest rpc myphone apps.uninstall` for com.example.app and it returned ok:false with code force_required. What do you do next? Show the commands you would run; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Reads the error and hint, checks or asks whether the user wants the forced action, and does not add force:true on its own.
assertions: Reads the force_required error and asks the user or checks the user's intent
Does not add force:true on retry unless the user asked for that action
Does not retry the same call unchanged in a loop

evals.prompt: Run apps.list on myphone and give me every installed app. The first response came back with truncated:true and a next_cursor. Show the commands you would run; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Calls apps.list again passing next_cursor as cursor, repeats until no next_cursor, and reports the full list.
assertions: Passes next_cursor back as cursor on the next apps.list call
Repeats until a response has no next_cursor
Does not claim the first page is the full list
Merges or reports results from all pages

evals.prompt: My guest rpc call on myphone fails with 客体代理未连接 and retryable:true right after boot. What do you do? Show the commands you would run; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Runs vm wait or pauses briefly and retries, at most 5 times, without recreating the machine, then stops and reports.
assertions: Retries after vm wait or a short pause
Does not recreate the machine
Stops and reports after at most 5 retries
Treats the error as transient because retryable is true
